content.content: We'd love to welcome you to our Saturday Repair Cafe at 10 a.m. this weekend! Join us for a community gathering where skilled volunteers help you fix household items and learn valuable repair skills—and repairs are free. Whether you bring a broken lamp, a malfunctioning toaster, or any other damaged goods, our experts are here to help you restore them. Don't miss this opportunity to save money, reduce waste, and connect with your neighbors in a fun and educational setting.
